# [Implementation] - [Phase 6] [Bug] Repo hygiene: the critique gate fails clean PRs, runners sit on deprecated runtimes, package-lock.json is stale, and --critique-report is undocumented

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #242 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

#### 1. Lockfile root metadata matches the manifest

```bash
set -e
node -e '
const pkg = require("./package.json");
const lock = require("./package-lock.json");
const strip = (p) => String(p).replace(/^\.\//, "");
const keys = (o) => Object.keys(o || {}).sort().join(",");
const root = lock.packages[""];
if (lock.version !== pkg.version) throw new Error("lock.version " + lock.version + " != package.json " + pkg.version);
if (root.version !== pkg.version) throw new Error("lock root version " + root.version + " != package.json " + pkg.version);
if (keys(root.bin) !== keys(pkg.bin)) throw new Error("lock bins [" + keys(root.bin) + "] != package.json [" + keys(pkg.bin) + "]");
for (const name of Object.keys(pkg.bin)) {
  if (strip(root.bin[name]) !== strip(pkg.bin[name])) throw new Error("bin " + name + " target drift: " + root.bin[name] + " vs " + pkg.bin[name]);
}
console.log("lockfile parity OK");
'
```

#### 2. The authoritative gate still blocks, and counts exactly once

```bash
set -e
node -e '
const { applyTwoTierInvariant } = require("./dist/application");
const { AiReviewReport, AiReviewFinding, ReviewConfidence, ReviewVerdict, VERDICT_APPROVED, VERDICT_CHANGES_REQUESTED } = require("./dist/domain");
const report = new AiReviewReport({
  summary: "one blocking finding",
  confidence: ReviewConfidence.high("static scan"),
  findings: [new AiReviewFinding({ path: "src/app.ts", line: 10, severity: "critical", body: "unsafe shell interpolation" })]
});
const verdict = new ReviewVerdict({ status: VERDICT_APPROVED, summary: "reviewer approved", confidenceLevel: "High" });
const outcome = applyTwoTierInvariant(verdict, report);
if (outcome.verdict.status !== VERDICT_CHANGES_REQUESTED) throw new Error("a blocking finding must escalate");
if (!outcome.verdict.summary.includes("detected 1 blocking/error violation(s)")) throw new Error("wrong count: " + outcome.verdict.summary);
if (outcome.verdict.summary.includes("detected 2")) throw new Error("the N+1 over-count is back: " + outcome.verdict.summary);
console.log("tier-1 escalation count OK");
'
```

#### 3. CI declares v7 actions, a pinned image set, SHA refs, and a collector trigger

```bash
set -e
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const ci = fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/ci.yml", "utf8");
const critique = fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/critique.yml", "utf8");
const both = ci + "\n" + critique;
const fail = (msg) => { throw new Error(msg); };
if (/actions\/(checkout|setup-node)@v[0-6]\b/.test(both)) fail("an action still targets a pre-v7 runtime");
if (!/fail_on_severity:\s*'"'"'none'"'"'/.test(critique)) fail("critique.yml must pass fail_on_severity explicitly");
if (!/uses:\s*ajxcodes\/critique@[0-9a-f]{40}/.test(critique)) fail("ajxcodes/critique is not SHA-pinned");
if (!/uses:\s*ajxcodes\/auto-tag@[0-9a-f]{40}/.test(ci)) fail("ajxcodes/auto-tag is not SHA-pinned");
if (/@latest\b/.test(both)) fail("a workflow still uses a floating @latest ref");
if (!ci.includes("phase/**")) fail("push trigger does not cover the collector branch");
const checkouts = (both.match(/uses: actions\/checkout@v7/g) || []).length;
const setups = (both.match(/uses: actions\/setup-node@v7/g) || []).length;
if (checkouts !== 6) fail("expected 6 checkout@v7 sites, found " + checkouts);
if (setups !== 5) fail("expected 5 setup-node@v7 sites, found " + setups);
const pinned = (ci.match(/^    runs-on: ubuntu-24\.04$/gm) || []).length;
const canary = (ci.match(/^    runs-on: ubuntu-latest$/gm) || []).length;
if (pinned !== 3) fail("expected 3 pinned jobs, found " + pinned);
if (canary !== 2) fail("expected 2 canary jobs, found " + canary);
if (!/^    runs-on: ubuntu-latest$/m.test(critique)) fail("the critique job must stay a canary");
if (!/npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts/.test(ci)) fail("no lockfile drift guard in CI");
if (!/git diff --exit-code -- package-lock\.json/.test(ci)) fail("the lockfile drift guard does not assert a clean lock");
console.log("workflow hygiene OK");
'
```

#### 4. `--critique-report` is documented where an operator looks first

```bash
set -e
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const { printHelp } = require("./dist/presentation/cli");
const original = console.log;
let help = "";
console.log = (...args) => { help += args.map(String).join(" ") + "\n"; };
try { printHelp(); } finally { console.log = original; }
const row = help.split("\n").find((line) => /^  review\s/.test(line));
if (!row) throw new Error("the help output has no review row");
if (!row.includes("--critique-report")) throw new Error("the review row does not name --critique-report: " + row);
if (!row.includes("--verdict-file")) throw new Error("the review row lost --verdict-file");
const flagLine = help.split("\n").find((line) => /^\s+--critique-report\s/.test(line));
if (!flagLine || !flagLine.includes("<path|->")) throw new Error("the flag list no longer documents --critique-report <path|->");
const skill = fs.readFileSync("skills/agyloop/SKILL.md", "utf8");
const skillRow = skill.split("\n").find((line) => line.startsWith("| `codeloop review`"));
if (!skillRow || !skillRow.includes("--critique-report")) throw new Error("SKILL.md does not document --critique-report on the review row");
const opencode = fs.readFileSync("integrations/opencode/codeloop-skill.md", "utf8");
if (!opencode.includes("--critique-report")) throw new Error("the OpenCode skill does not mention --critique-report");
if (!/no critique subprocess|hermetic|already-produced/i.test(opencode)) throw new Error("the OpenCode skill does not explain when to use --critique-report");
console.log("docs contract OK");
'
```

#### 5. The dispatch-counter warning is byte-identical for all four counters

```bash
set -e
node -e '
const { formatDispatchCounterUnrecorded, DISPATCH_COUNTER_KINDS } = require("./dist/domain");
const statePath = "/tmp/demo/.agyloop/tasks/242.json";
const kinds = ["review", "discovery", "plan", "implementation"];
if (JSON.stringify([...DISPATCH_COUNTER_KINDS]) !== JSON.stringify(kinds)) throw new Error("counter vocabulary drifted: " + DISPATCH_COUNTER_KINDS.join(","));
for (const kind of kinds) {
  const expected = "[codeloop] Warning: could not record the " + kind + " dispatch counter at " + statePath + "; returning the directive unchanged.";
  const actual = formatDispatchCounterUnrecorded(kind, statePath);
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(kind + " warning drifted: " + actual);
  const generic = actual.split(kind).join("<counter>");
  if (generic !== "[codeloop] Warning: could not record the <counter> dispatch counter at " + statePath + "; returning the directive unchanged.") throw new Error("the template is not shared: " + actual);
}
console.log("dispatch-counter warning OK");
'
```

#### 6. Both shipped reviewer prompts carry the verdict-filing contract

```bash
set -e
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const { DEFAULT_REVIEWER_SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT } = require("./dist/domain");
const file = fs.readFileSync("prompts/reviewer.md", "utf8");
const prompts = [["prompts/reviewer.md", file], ["DEFAULT_REVIEWER_SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT", DEFAULT_REVIEWER_SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT]];
for (const [name, text] of prompts) {
  for (const token of ["codeloop review --issue", "--verdict-file", "--verdict-stdin"]) {
    if (!text.includes(token)) throw new Error(name + " does not name " + token);
  }
  if (!/Recording the verdict/i.test(text)) throw new Error(name + " has no Recording the verdict section");
}
console.log("reviewer prompt parity OK");
'
```
